Lead weekly sections to solidify understanding of course content such as assembly language programming, caches, and CPU design
Hold weekly office hours and assist students one-on-one

positions.description:
Led a weekly small-group mentoring section and host one-on-one check-ins over the course of the semester. 
Taught course content in Computer Architecture and assisted with content review sessions.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Initiated implementation of Auth0 to generate tokens that allow users to securely login
Configured Istio to route requests, manage traffic, and display logging info using Prometheus, Grefana, and Kiali
Trained a model to find similar images and inserted data to a MongoDB cloud cluster

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Collaborated with VMware Enablement team in Shared Engineering
Created an automated tool for CSI department that monitored multiple processes simultaneously to detect potential memory leaks for extended durations
